title: Attendance
needsCredits: Checked in without spending a credit. This member needs more credits.
walkInBusy: Another check-in is still saving. Choose the member again once it finishes.
walkInError: Members could not be searched. Please try again.
rosterLoadError: The roster could not be loaded. Refresh attendance to try again.
stale: This roster may be out of date. Refresh attendance to try again.
error: Attendance could not be loaded or saved. Please try again.
undoHelp: Remove this check-in for {name}? Any class credit spent on it returns to its original pack.
noRosterHelp: Booked and waitlisted members appear here. Use Check in someone else for a walk-in.
openMatHelp: Record a visit without a scheduled class. Repeat check-ins on the same gym-local day return the existing visit. Open mat counts toward classes attended only if the gym setting is on.
